messages:
sasha: Morning async — quick standup (what I did / blockers / today)

sasha: what I did: landed prefetch-evict heuristic into canary lane, ran a 1M-token microbench against kernel-v2, and pushed the bench harness updates (added more hist buckets).
sasha: blockers: seeing p99 tail spike when concurrent requests cause a KV-evict sequence; hard to repro locally, need more slot-level metrics and a couple extra logs in the eviction path.
sasha: today: add slot-metrics export + extra logging around eviction decision, run the canary perf pass again, and prepare a quick rollback test in case the canary regresses.

li: nice. can you paste the bench numbers you saw? p95/p99 + GPU util?
sasha: paste from the run: 
````
P50 11.8ms
P95 21.9ms
P99 118.3ms
avg 12.6ms
throughput ~1.8k tok/s per GPU (batch window=10ms)
GPU util ~62%
mem pressure spiked ~72% on node-3 during the tail event
````

jamie: those p99 numbers are higher than expected given util. could be queueing when eviction blocks KV reads. did you try bumping the batch-window down to 6-8ms to reduce inflight depth?
sasha: not yet, wanted to gather metrics first. good call — will try 8ms next.

pranav: on the KV side, current eviction threshold is 70%. that might be too conservative for canary traffic. suggest toggling to 85% for the next run and pinning hot keys for an extra 30s TTL to see effect. also I have a small probe script (runs per-shard) that can simulate a hotkey churn: /srv/tools/kv-evict-probe.sh
pranav: quick curl to trigger the canary endpoint if you need: `curl -XPOST https://infra-canary.redwood/api/v1/debug/run -d '{"route":"kernel-canary","mode":"probe"}'`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated for kernel-v2 on pool:gpu-canary-3 — started at 1729995120 — build #2892

maria: I'll take the logging + metrics export task. will open a PR with the prometheus metric names and the small patch to emit slot_id + evict_reason. linking to CI in the PR. pinging @sasha when it's up.

sasha: thanks! also need a quick CR for #4321 (kernel: slot-metrics + tiny refactor). @jamie can you take a look after you finish the batch-window test?

jamie: on it. plan: run batch-window=8ms, toggle kv threshold to 85% for one run, then grab histograms and flamegraphs. ETA ~2h.

li: if you get the flamegraphs post-run, drop them here and I'll do a quick pass for syscall stalls / kernel scheduling artifacts.

pranav: noted. if eviction still triggers tail, I'll instrument the eviction path with a short trace-id header to correlate traces.

sasha: ok — plan agreed. small TODOs: 1) maria opens metrics PR 2) sasha runs batch-window=8ms perf 3) pr toggles kv threshold on canary 4) jamie grabs flamegraphs 5) li reviews. will update if any regressions. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — starting PR now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary health checks passing (3/3) at 1729995360

sasha: closing async standup — post results here when you have them.
